newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco B jumps 6.19 pct in mid-trade.
newsitem.headline: Meralco B jumps 6.19 pct in mid-trade.

text.p: Class B shares of Manila Electric Co (Meralco) rose by seven pesos, or 6.19 percent, to 120 pesos in mid-trade on Tuesday, on bargain-hunting, brokers said.
"It looks like a lot of selling pressure has eased and some people are on a bargain hunt for good stocks," said Saturnino Mejia, research head at Guoco Securities.
"There's no news about the company and its gains are due to bargain hunting. There seems to be short covering in the general market," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities.
The Philippine stock market's main index, which opened weaker on Tuesday, rose by 11.23 points at mid-session to 2,520.59.

Last week, Meralco B shares suffered a beating on newspaper reports that the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) may allow foreigners to own the less costly A shares. At present foreigners are only allowed to own B shares.
The SEC later denied such a report and said it will not compel the declassification of the A and B shares.
